name: Interning God
source:
Help answer a small town’s unfulfilled wishes before it’s destroyed in 3 days..

A visual novel about an interning god who is watching over a small town, but doomsday is fated to happen. Play as the intern god and see through those humans' lives.

[from [url=https://silvermercurius.itch.io/interninggod]itch.io[/url]]
